code.statement: BELIEVE IN YOURSELF. BACK IT UP.
AIM FOR GREATNESS. MEDIOCRITY NEVER INSPIRED ANYONE.
BUILD YOUR OWN MOMENTUM. THIS RIPPLE WILL BE A TSUNAMI.
FOLLOW YOUR INTUITION. YOUR GUT FEELING IS NEVER WRONG.
DON’T THINK. JUST DO. ANALYSE LATER.
STICK AROUND LONG ENOUGH TO SEE THE RESULTS.
DO IT FOR YOUR YOUNGER SELF.
ADD VALUE. GIVE MORE THAN YOU TAKE.
THE MOMENT YOU STOP LEARNING, IT’S GAME OVER.
WITHOUT PURPOSE, YOU HAVE NO DIRECTION.

codeArchive.alt: The original handwritten 13 Laws of GALANACCI

missions.label: COMPLETED MISSION
missions.title: BUILD THE HANDS
missions.objective: LEARN THE CRAFT FROM THE GROUND UP.
missions.brief: Six months shadowing Robert Jesse built practical fluency in pattern making, drafting, industrial sewing and garment construction. The training became real when those skills returned to PoG.

missions.label: COMPLETED MISSION
missions.title: FORGE THE JACKET
missions.objective: TAKE THE FORGE DENIM JACKET FROM V1 TO A RESOLVED SAMPLE.
missions.brief: Pattern drafting, cutting, sewing, dyeing, hardware, screenprinting and repeated mistakes moved the jacket through four samples until its design language held together.

missions.label: COMPLETED MISSION
missions.title: TEST THE WORLD
missions.objective: WEAR THE PRODUCT, BUILD THE IMAGE AND PROVE THE LANGUAGE OUTSIDE THE STUDIO.
missions.brief: FORGE travelled through Japan alongside the denim jeans prototype. Product testing became photography, campaign material and the first clear view of the world surrounding the clothes.

missions.label: COMPLETED MISSION
missions.title: DELIVER THE FIRST ORDER
missions.objective: TAKE FORGE FROM SAMPLE TO A FINISHED MADE-TO-ORDER GARMENT.
missions.brief: The jacket moved beyond prototyping. The first order was constructed with felled seams, followed by a custom piece graded to a new size, cut in a different denim and adapted to its wearer.

missions.label: COMPLETED MISSION
missions.title: EXPAND THE LANGUAGE
missions.objective: PROVE THAT FORGE CAN BECOME A SYSTEM, NOT A SINGLE JACKET.
missions.brief: The language expanded into a denim vest, jeans, new construction ideas and rapid-prototyped accessories. Form, function, material and detail began connecting products without depending on logos.

missions.label: CURRENT MISSION
missions.title: SECURE THE RUNWAY
missions.objective: BUILD THE FINANCIAL AND DIGITAL FOUNDATION THAT KEEPS POG MOVING.
missions.brief: Restore stability without abandoning the vision. Secure dependable income, protect creative capacity and finish a digital world that documents what PoG is becoming beyond the products.

journey.title: ARCHITECTURE
copy: Before fashion, there was architecture. It taught me to think through structure, proportion and purpose — and, more importantly, how to take something that exists only in the mind and give it physical form.

journey.title: THE PIVOT
copy: I walked away from the path I had trained for without knowing exactly where the next one would lead. There was no master plan. I only knew that I wanted to create on my own terms — and I was willing to accept the uncertainty that came with it.

journey.title: GALANACCI
copy: GALANACCI became the place where I learned what kind of creator I was. Fashion, illustration, footwear, objects, storytelling — I experimented across disciplines without asking permission to stay in one lane. Years of making taught me that the medium could change while the mind behind it remained the same.

journey.title: GREATNESS
copy: Before PIONEERS OF GREATNESS had a name, a product or an identity, there was a question that kept following me: what does it actually take to become great? I wrote GREATNESS as an attempt to put that pursuit into words. I didn't know it at the time, but I had written the foundation of what would eventually become PoG.

journey.title: PIONEERS OF GREATNESS

media.alt: PIONEERS OF GREATNESS — original Journey artefact

copy: Boxing gave GREATNESS a language. Discipline. Sacrifice. Solitude. Resilience. The willingness to keep going when circumstances aren't in your favour. PIONEERS OF GREATNESS became a way of giving that philosophy an identity — and eventually, a world of its own.

journey.title: THE FIRST PIECE

media.alt: THE FIRST PIECE — original Journey artefact

copy: Until this point, PIONEERS OF GREATNESS existed as an idea. The first piece changed that. Patterns, prototypes, mistakes, revisions and construction turned philosophy into something that could finally be worn. What had lived in my head now existed in the real world.

journey.title: THE FIRST SALE

media.alt: THE FIRST SALE — original Journey artefact

copy: The first sale was small in the scale of what I'm trying to build, but enormous in what it represented. Someone exchanged their money for something that had once existed only in my imagination. PoG was no longer something only I believed in.

journey.title: NOW — 2026
copy: There is no ending to write here yet. I'm still building PoG while living the philosophy it represents — working with what I have, adapting when circumstances change and continuing when the path isn't clear. The products are evolving. The world is expanding. The community is still being built.
